name: Recipes
lead: `game.recipes`: what a crafting grid and a furnace make of a pack's items. Load-time only, like a block definition. The game's own recipes are asked first, so a pack adds and never takes away.

functions.name: shaped
functions.signature: recipes.shaped(spec: { pattern: { string }, keys: { [string]: ItemMatch }, result: ItemSpec })
functions.description: 1 to 3 rows of 1 to 3 letters; a space is an empty cell.

functions.name: shapeless
functions.description: Adds a crafting recipe whose ingredients may go anywhere in the grid.

functions.name: smelt
functions.description: Adds a furnace recipe; a furnace smelts a pack item only by one of these.
